description: What a disk's answer to ATA CHECK POWER MODE says, read from the sense data of an ATA PASS-THROUGH (16) sent with CK_COND set: the count it returns, from the ATA Status Return descriptor (code 09h) of descriptor-format sense data, or from the information field of fixed-format sense data whose additional sense code is 00h/1Dh, ATA pass-through information available. Its status must not have ERR set. 00h, 01h and 40h are standby, the disk spun down; 41h, 80h to 83h and FFh are spinning; anything else, or no such answer, says nothing (null).
